answers.core:
New users, like me, are not even aware that such important files are hidden there. So I've opened some demos, couldn't understand what was going on, and I had no clue there was a readme explaining some details, or giving reference material.

If the README is more visible/reacheable, it will also encourage authors of demos to write more explanations to it.
answers.workaround: You want the basic tools to help people learn to be built-in so they can help newcomers with as little friction as possible. This also encourages authors to write more/better READMEs, they need to be easily accessible and discoverable.

title: Display README files in the FileSystem dock
